text:
alex: quick idea  should we add an "auth path inspector" to the Console for incoming API calls? basically a tiny panel that answers: which key type (org/project/sa) matched, which billing project was used, and what quota bucket applied. could cut support time a lot.

mina: i like it. keep it collapsed by default though. show top-line: principal_type, billing_project, quota_bucket, reason. expand for the rule chain. admins get full expand.

juan: strong redaction requirements here. matcher values often contain emails or 3rd-party ids. we should hash those before storing in telemetry and never render raw values unless explicitly unmasked by an admin with audit.

alex: agreed. minimal default payload proposal in telemetry: policy_name, policy_version, matched_scope_type, matched_scope_id_hash, quota_bucket, billing_project, resolve_ts, sampled. sample=false for most records.

mina: also add a feature-flag gate: `console.auth_path_inspector` default off for orgs >100k rps. enable via admin toggle for support orgs. rate-limit UI detail fetches (1 per 10s per user).

juan: sample payload example:
```json
{
  "policy_name": "org_priority",
  "policy_version": "2026-03-21-07",
  "matched_scope_type": "project",
  "matched_scope_id_hash": "sha256:9ab3...",
  "quota_bucket": "compute-heavy",
  "billing_project": "proj-42",
  "billing_assertion_source": "token_claim",
  "impersonation": "false",
  "resolve_ts": "2026-03-21T20:02:17Z",
  "sampled": "false"
}
```

alex: when sampled=false and an admin clicks "show details" we should attempt a pull from the policy store (rate-limited) and return a cached snapshot if available. otherwise show "snapshot unavailable".

mina: also track analytic event `console.auth_path_view` with a sample rate so we don't blow observability budgets. note: viewing unmasked details should create an audit event and count against admin quotas.

ops-bot: deploy queued: web-console v3.17.0 -> canary (flag: console.auth_path_inspector) ETA 14m.

juan: final security note: use org-local salt for hashing matched ids so support can correlate within an org but we don't leak cross-org correlation. and redact any header values that look like tokens.

alex: great. i'll write a short RFC with fields, masking rules, sampling defaults, and the rollout plan. linking follow-up ticket when i file it. :thumbsup:
